title: Activation Cartography
description: Maps predicted cortical activation for <inode id="3008-stimuli">3,008 text stimuli</inode> across 13 internet content categories using TRIBE v2, finding a <inode id="one-way-anova">statistically significant category effect</inode> best explained by <inode id="global-workspace-theory">Global Workspace Theory</inode>.

13-content-categories.title: 13 Content Categories
13-content-categories.description: Stimuli were sorted into categories such as ThreatSafety, News, Social, Scientific, Narrative, Emotional, AudioText, ImageVisual, Educational, Persuasive, Humour, Instructional, and Commerce.

3008-stimuli.title: 3,008 Stimuli
3008-stimuli.description: Short 1-3 sentence natural language passages drawn from established NLP benchmarks and live internet sources, distributed across the 13 categories.

hash-mode-encoding.title: Hash-mode Encoding
hash-mode-encoding.description: Fast, token-level encoding used as the primary analysis, under which ThreatSafety content ranked highest and Narrative lowest (Cohen's d = -0.82).

semantic-mode-replication.title: Semantic-mode Replication
semantic-mode-replication.description: A secondary encoding using LLaMA-3.2-3B embeddings on an N = 390 sample, producing a 4x wider activation spread led by AudioText, ImageVisual, and Emotional content.

whole-cortex-prediction.title: Whole-cortex Prediction
whole-cortex-prediction.description: Each stimulus yields a predicted haemodynamic response across 20,484 cortical surface points, summarised into six anatomical regions for comparison.

one-way-anova.title: One-way ANOVA
one-way-anova.description: Tested whether predicted global activation differed by content category, returning a significant main effect: F(12, 2995) = 13.51, p < 10⁻²⁶, η² = 0.051.

dominant-cortical-gradient.title: Dominant Cortical Gradient (PCA)
dominant-cortical-gradient.description: A single principal component contrasting sensory-language cortex against executive-motor cortex explained 96.9% of between-category variance, consistent across encoding modes.

effect-size-comparison.title: Effect Size Comparison
effect-size-comparison.description: Cohen's d = -0.82 between the highest-ranked (ThreatSafety) and lowest-ranked (Narrative) categories <inode id="hash-mode-encoding">under hash-mode encoding</inode>.

vertex-level-analysis.title: Vertex-level Analysis
vertex-level-analysis.description: Independent <inode id="one-way-anova">per-vertex ANOVAs</inode> run across all 20,484 points showed the discriminative effect is whole-brain, with 99.8% of vertices significant at p < 0.001 and a top vertex F = 71.05.

cross-source-reproducibility.title: Cross-source Reproducibility
cross-source-reproducibility.description: An ICC-style index computed across categories sourced from two or more datasets gave a mean ICC of 0.89, with 10 of 12 categories in the good-to-excellent range.

encoding-stability-tests.title: Encoding Stability Tests
encoding-stability-tests.description: The seq_len sweep (ρ ≥ 0.956 across window sizes) and an LSA Mantel test (r = 0.055) showed <inode id="semantic-mode-replication">the semantic-mode ranking</inode> is stable and not driven by surface text similarity.

global-workspace-theory.title: Global Workspace Theory
global-workspace-theory.description: Received the strongest support (scorecard 0.58): ThreatSafety's top ranking and <inode id="dominant-cortical-gradient">the single dominant 96.9% variance gradient</inode> both match GWT's prediction of broad cortical ignition from threat content.

free-energy-principle.title: Free Energy Principle
free-energy-principle.description: Received weak support (scorecard 0.25): high-surprise categories like ThreatSafety and News ranked highly, but correlation with uncertainty proxies was weak (r ≈ 0.3).

default-mode-circuit-theory-iit.title: Default-mode Circuit Theory & IIT
default-mode-circuit-theory-iit.description: Both tied at a scorecard of 0.33 with mixed evidence — Narrative's default-mode prediction flipped between encoding modes, and IIT's integrated information (Φ) had no reliable proxy in text stimuli.
